name: Total Loss Function for Neural Scene Reconstruction
definition: The total loss function combines seven components to train the neural scene reconstruction model: RGB loss ($L_c$), normal loss ($L_n$), depth loss ($L_d$), Eikonal loss ($L_e$), smooth loss ($L_s$), SRDF-SDF consistency loss ($L_{con}$), and visibility loss ($L_{vis}$).
summary: It is a composite training objective that stabilizes neural scene reconstruction by combining photometric, geometric, and regularization terms, distinguished by explicit 2.5D geometric supervision and 3D visibility priors.
